messages:
sec-bot: EDR alert: Suspicious downloader behavior detected on host 'dev-laptop-23' (agent: ag-9f3b). File flagged: /tmp/.apt-cache/update.bin, SHA256=3b9f8a6c4d2e... Behavior: spawned curl -> wrote binary -> executed. Action taken: auto-quarantine of /tmp/.apt-cache/update.bin
harper: On it. can we get the full agent id + hostname + user?
sec-bot: agent_id: ag-9f3b, hostname: dev-laptop-23, user: samir, os: ubuntu-22.04, first_seen: 1987654300
samir: yep that was me. ran `sudo apt-get update` earlier and pulled from our internal mirror. didn't expect it to write to /tmp/.apt-cache. laptop felt laggy after.
harper: do NOT reboot, isolate first. ops-ella, can you push remote scan + quarantine check? Also capture /var/log/apt/* and auditd logs for 1987654200-1987654320
ops-ella: running remote commands now: `edrctl run-scan --agent ag-9f3b --paths /tmp/.apt-cache --yara-file /tmp/sigs.yar`
ops-ella: scan result: suspicious loader found at /tmp/.apt-cache/update.bin, perms 700, owned by samir. SHA256=3b9f8a6c4d2e9b7a5c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3
ops-ella: quarantined file, created artifact bundle at /var/edr/artifacts/ag-9f3b/1987654321.tar.gz
harper: grab the artifact, upload to VT and internal malware lab. add YARA snippet for this pattern: ```rule AptDownloader { meta: source = "edr" strings: $s1 = "/tmp/.apt-cache" $s2 = "update.bin" condition: any of them }```
luke: isolate host from network (VLAN isolation), revoke active workstation sessions, remove from jump-host group. samir, do you remember visiting any weird mirror URL?
samir: only our mirror at mirror.redwood.internal. but I did click a link in a build log yesterday that opened a random gist with install instructions. could be supply-chain.
harper: treat as potential supply-chain compromise until proven otherwise. escalate to incident channel if artifacts show payloads. open INC-2026-0423 and add notes + audit log pointers. we'll need KMS access checks too — verify if any KMS decrypt calls happened from that host in the window (key: projects/redwood-kms/keys/infra-key)
maria: helpdesk will reach out to Samir, collect laptop for imaging if we need it. prepping blank image and corp-approved packages.
sec-bot: quarantine confirmed, endpoint isolated. scheduled full disk scan at 1987654380. artifact upload queued to malware-lab.
harper: RBAC immediate action: restrict `remote-shell` and `edr-respond` privileges to sec-team and ops-sre for 7d, add entry in audit logs for all remote responses. Follow-ups: 1) upload artifact to VT + internal lab, 2) check KMS decrypt logs for infra-key between 1987654200-1987654400, 3) push YARA sig to EDR fleet, 4) org sweep for similar /tmp/.apt-cache files, 5) security comms + brief for eng managers.
luke: will block the mirror at infra proxy until we confirm it's clean.
harper: OK. logging actions to INC-2026-0423 and linking artifact bundle. who will own remediation play? ops-ella take lead, harper will handle detection rules and RBAC audit.
ops-ella: taking ownership of remediation and reimage coordination. will post status updates to incident channel.
harper: thanks — keep messages short and post key artifacts. closing note: no broad creds rotation yet, but if KMS shows decrypts from that agent we'll rotate infra-key and notify product.
